title: crataegus scabrida var. hadleyana
intro: Crataegus scabrida var. hadleyana, commonly known as Hadley's hawthorn or Hadley's hawthorn tree, is a plant species within the Rosaceae family. It is a small tree or shrub native to China and has been used in traditional medicine for its health benefits, including reducing blood pressure, improving cardiovascular health, and acting as an antidiabetic agent. The plant's therapeutic actions include antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and cardiovascular protective effects, which may be attributed to its bioactive constituents such as flavonoids, triterpenoids, and phenolic acids. These constituents contribute to the plant's potential health benefits and therapeutic uses, although further research is needed to confirm their efficacy and safety in human applications.
